company_info.company_description: "We are privately owned and operated. We specialise in solar designs and installations, and provide a range of general electrical services in domestic and commercial sectors across Brisbane, Gold Coast and surrounding areas.Our mission is to provide expert, high quality service to clients and businesses alike. We are passionate about what we do and how we deliver it. We take great pride in the fact that we stand out from other companies through our high quality of work, professionalism and honesty."
company_info.specializations: solar designs and installations, and provide a range of general electrical services in domestic and commercial sectors across Brisbane, Gold Coast and surrounding areas

reviews.review_description: The initial Sales/ Quoting process with "Abraham" was very good, however communication was fairly tardy and this stopped completely after installation as we tried multiple time to follow up the pending installation of the Tigo Monitoring System & access to their App .The Tradesman were punctual, polite, clean up after themselves & provided a high quality Installation, however their knowledge of the Tigo Monitoring system & the included App (we paid an extra $1,000 for this to obtain a 25 year Guarantee to 14 x Tigo Optimisers attached to each panel) is very poor, as it was immediately apparent that this company had never installed this system beforehand (The Tigo Monitoring System still doesn't talk to/ link to our Sigenergy App which were originally told that this would happen).Panels, Invertor, Optimisers and the Solar system commissioning was completed on Monday 28th July 2025 and the Tigo Monitoring App was only completed on Tuesday 16th September 2025.When our 47 cent feed in tariff stops in July 2028 and we need to upgrade our Solar System (will purchase more Panels and at least 3 x Batteries) we're not confident that Ethos Electrical will respond to further communications from us.

Great process from the initial quote from Abraham, quick turnaround time from paying the deposit to Joshua and Mitch installing the battery – one week – would have been quicker but I was not available when the team wanted to come first. Very knowledgeable and helpful of all aspects of the process and product. Very clean workmanship, very polite and organized all the paperwork and a pleasure to deal with.

Great process from the first communication through quoting, installation and after care.Provided multiple solar choices in a clear and easy to read quoting platform. Came on site to inspect our roof and building layout to ensure a suitable solution to fit.Crew on site during install we're all friendly and respectful. Got to work and took all rubbish with them. Provided a walkthrough of the system before leaving.Hard to find fault or ask for anything more.

Mitch was very knowledgeable about solar he talked us through the pros and cons of different brands of inverters and batteries. He answered all our questions with detailed answers.The team were really professional. Everyone had their jobs, it was like clock work. Everthing was up and running by lunchtime. Very happy!

The installer was prompt and polite, took the time to explain everything and answer my questions, inspected the site including the roof and shade areas before providing the quote. They organised everything: paperwork, grid connection, moving and installing a new switchboard, the wiring for and the plumber to install a new hot water heating system. They went through how everything works including the Apps. The system was installed within 2 weeks of accepting the quote.

Mitch and his team installed a great system at a good price and we would recommend Ethos Electrical to anyone looking for solar or a battery. He was polite and informative when quoting and a pleasure to deal with after installation.
Great local company. The owner is the installer and an electrician. Got a very competative quote. All work done was very clean and effecient

I would highly recommend Mitch and the guys from Ethos Electrical for your solar system, from the word go everything was smooth and painless, careful and tidy guys who provided us with a system that is running beautifully, layout looks great to with consideration of shaded roof sections throughout the changing seasons, very happy customer.
Easy quoting processPolite, tidy, punctualGood, yes, they assisted in organising the grid connection after the installation.

Mitchell was very generous with his time & super knowledgeable. Very competitive on price & was easy to organise an install that suited my schedule. I got a full run down of the system & features post-install & an offer to keep me posted on any future battery deals to complement my system. Highly recommended.

Mitch impressed me from our initial contact as standing out from the numerous other installers I spoke to (not only sourced from SolarQuotes). He was forthright about what I could expect price wise, didn't try to do a hard sell on high margin gear, and answered every question I put to him with detailed information.When I contacted him to ask about the installation under some time pressure after having left it for some months, he provided detailed quotes for several different options with a very quick turnaround time, and set up the dates for the installation and some additional electrical work including the installation of a smart EV charger in a minimal time frame.His work crew were all punctual, professional and polite, including the apprentices, and put in some extra long hours to get the job done rather than pushing it to an extra day.Very good people and I would recommend Ethos to anyone willing to pay a fair price for quality equipment installed by people who know what they're doing.
Very easy to work with. They did a great job for the best price I could find. I highly recommend them and will definitely use them again in the future.
Mitch and his team, were awesome. His knowledge and passion were a cut above the rest. Highly recommended. Thanks again, Greg

Ethos Electrical - Thank you!Your service up to the installation phase was very helpful and honest and the installation although delayed by rain was carried out in a professional and timely manner,Thank you again,Joe
Great informative information about product how they work as a an organisation.Team that fitted the system on were great and the electrician was helpful and helped explain the layout of the system
Mitch and his team were great during the whole process, quoting and installation.I would recommend them to anyone.

Mitchell from Ethos Electrical was excellent to work with. Very responsive to emails and questions. Explained the pros and cons of the different options we had suggested. Provided a very competitive quote. Arrived on time. Clean installation. Discussed the operation of the system and Mitchell guided us through everything. Very happy and would highly recommend.
Great customer service. Install was easy and the guys were respectful and polite.

I can’t recommend Ethos Electrical enough. They replaced my old solar system and inverter. The price was fantastic and the service was impressive. Thank you Mitchell for a professional job done quickly and efficiently.

Ethos Electrical stands out for its integrity and transparent pricing, clear communication, excellence in workmanship and outstanding customer service from start to finish. Unlike other companies, Mitch provided an exact quote for the job from the very start, as opposed to a “weekly repayment amount based off what we could afford”, which was very refreshing, after speaking with 6 other solar companies. Mitch provided us with every possible option (brands, size, price etc) for our specific needs and was totally transparent with the exact cost and timeframe. One of the biggest benefits of choosing Ethos Electrical is the fact they do all their own installations. No outsourcing or buck passing and an excellent warranty period on all of their work!! To our surprise and delight, Mitch and his team had our new solar system and battery installed and making us money, all in one day! This included the removal of our old system too! Furthermore, all of this was completed just 2 weeks after we first called!!  We couldn’t be happier with our choice and are so very grateful to Mitch and his team for their efficient, quality and professional work. I highly recommend this FIRST CLASS BUSINESS!

Had 4 quotes.Choose a local supplier. I choose a battery system.All went to plan. Supplier was very professional. Install done in one day as per the agreed time line.System came on line and I have not had any problems, been running for a mth now.Will advise to do your homework. Make sure you know how the system works and how to get your hot water system (if it runs on eleco) up and working at the time of the day when your system is generating the most power.The more you know the better you are able to sort through issues with the supplier.It was very pleasing to have the install go to plan with all stages of the process having no issues.

Very happy with Ethos Electrical installation of our Solar System. They gave us a quality install with their professional knowledge and   advice. We have a difficult install which posed no problem for this team. Very neat installation as well.

I purchased a 16kwh battery system + inverter from Ethos Electrical.During the quoting process there was no pressure and Mitchell was knowledgeable and responsive regarding several iterative changes to the quote.During the installation process everything was explained clearly and relevant apps and accounts were setup and tutorialed thoroughly. I've also never expected a sparkie leave a job site looking so tidy.The final system runthrough and setup explanations were clear and thorough. Mitchell said he would submit the application for dynamic connection the same day and I received an Energex notfiication regarding the submission almost immediately afterward.It was overall an excellent experience.

I had a milion questions and were always answered punctually and in detail. You can tell with the half-hearted replies, and this was definintely not the case here. Installation was great, neat and tidy. Thanks and callout to Mitch for staying late to finish the battery then taking even more time to show me how it all works. In detail. Really appreciate it!

All of the Ethos Electrical team were professional, polite and punctual.Luke listen to me and I was given three quotes based on my budget and preferences.The installation was hassle and mess free.Mitch explained the system and monitoring.Positive experience.
The quote, grid connection, installation & Commissioning all went seamlessly.A Big System with Battery, no more imports or reliance on the Grid. Energy Independence.

From quote to install, our experience was nothing short of fantastic. They had a quote to us within 24 hours from first contact. We couldn't recommend Mitch and the team highly enough. Not only did they give us the best price, they were very professional throughout the entire process. Their communication was great and the system looks sooo good and performs exceptionally well. After the install, which only took one day, Mitch took us through operating and shutdown procedures and set up the monitoring system on the mobile phone.

I can't speak more highly of Mitch and his team and have no hesitation in recommending him. From the beginning he was very prompt, open, ethical and fair in the quoting process and answered all questions without hesitation. There was no high pressure sales techniques applied, he listened to what I required, offered suggestions, that reduced my overall expenditure and provided an honest fair quote, including switching my swimming pool from Tariff 33 to Tariff 11 and  the removal and disposal of my old panels. He installed a Jinko12.7Kwh PVC system, Sungrow 10Kwh Hybrid Inverter and Sungrow 12.7kwh Lithium Iron Phosphate Battery. He completed all paperwork and submitted them to Energex, so I had nothing to worry about.The installation went smoothly, with the exception of the Inverter, which Sungrow delivered 7 days later than promised which was out of Mitch's control.I found Mitch, very easy to talk to, extremely honest and very professional in what he does.  He only deals in quality equipment so you have no worries about the performance of  the fit. It was a pleasure working with him and his team and I would not hesitate to do business with him again in the future.

Ethos Electrical did a great job installing a 6.6 kW system on our roof. I'd happily recommend them.Upfront service was good, the owner helped tweak the specs on a system to suit our requirements, booked it in promptly (without being pushy in any way) and about a week later the team turned up and did about the neatest install you've ever seen.They did some associated electrical work free of charge as part of the install, took care of the paperwork, thoroughly briefed me on the new system and helped me get the app up and running on my phone.I opted not to have a consumption meter installed for various reasons of my own. No doubt that if I'd put one in as per their recommendation Ethos would be monitoring my system right now for any anomalies.  As it is I'm checking the output daily and it's been absolutely cranking out the watts (its doing 35 kW a day right now in the peak of summer with minor shading).

Ethos Electrical were the first company to quote for our job. They were prompt and answered all of my questions satisfactorily. They gave multiple options for different prices/quality/warranty.Ultimately we choose Ethos over another company because they were able to install our system 8 days after we made our decision compared to waiting over a month for the other company.  Installation happened on the day and time they said they would.  They were punctual, polite and cleaned up the site.  They even gave advice to us on how to sell the old solar cells that they dismantled. Customer service has been great.  They organised the government rebate and sell back to the grid options.I would recommend Ethos Electrical for solar installations to anyone looking to install or upgrade their solar.

I would not hesitate to recommend Mitch and his team from Ethos. They did a great job installing our solar upgrade.Mitch replied to my quote punctually and I felt he was trustworthy and knowledgeable.The installed system looks great and perfectly placed. Everything was explained and completed with connection to the grid and internet. He took away all the packaging and left us very happy customers.
Mitch and the team were on time, professional, polite and knowledgeable. The guys stayed late to make sure everything was working. Highly recommend Ethos Electrical for solar and electrical services.

Prospective hardware reliability was of great importance, since a previous PV system suffered an Inverter failure.Mitchell, guided me through hardware options to arrive at a suitable hardware/cost solution.Mitch owns the business and is keen for it to succeed, so his demeanour and customer attention was great!I happily recommend Ethos for conventional Solar PV installation.

Mitchell was very friendly, helpful and clearly knowledgeable about all things solar. He took the time to explain the different systems and made it very easy to choose the correct one for our needs.The install process was a big day for him and his offsider Darren as they were short a man. To their absolute credit the two of them put in at least a 12 hour day to complete the job.Everything else such as Energex and grid connection paperwork has also been handled by them.I have no hesitation in recommending Mitchell and Ethos Electrical for solar, or for that matter any, electrical work. I am sure we will be dealing with them again.
